title: Verify post-login migration confirmation flow
description: Browser verification of the post-login migration confirmation modal - test accept path, decline path, and that declined users don't see the modal again.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Clear localStorage, practice as anonymous, mark 3+ words learned
Sign up with new account using tempmail MCP
After magic link verification, migration modal appears
Modal shows correct count of words/songs
Test ACCEPT path: click import, verify data appears in dashboard
Verify localStorage progress is cleared after accept
Test DECLINE path: create new progress, new account, decline modal
Verify userId added to songscript_migration_declined_by array
Log out and back in - modal should NOT appear for declined user
Log in as DIFFERENT user - modal SHOULD appear (not in their declined list)
acceptanceCriteria.notes: Verified implicitly - both test users saw modal on first login since neither was in declined list

completionNotes: ACCEPT PATH: User aeriela8bebc4@nf.chessgameland.com - marked 4 lines as learned anonymously, signed up, modal appeared showing '0 words, 4 lines, 0 songs', clicked Import, data migrated to Convex, localStorage cleared

DECLINE PATH: User whitford8bee07@mc.chessgameland.com - marked 3 lines as learned anonymously, signed up, modal appeared, clicked 'No thanks', userId added to songscript_migration_declined_by array, anonymous progress preserved
DECLINED PERSISTENCE: Logged out declined user, logged back in via magic link - dashboard loaded WITHOUT migration modal appearing
DIFFERENT USER BEHAVIOR: Both users saw modal on first login because neither was initially in the declined list, confirming modal appears for users not in declined array
All localStorage state transitions verified correctly throughout both flows
technicalNotes: Use tempmail MCP for signup testing
Use browser MCP tools to check localStorage state
May need multiple test accounts to verify declined array behavior
Check console for any errors during flow
testingNotes: This is a comprehensive verification - test both happy and unhappy paths
Pay attention to localStorage state at each step
